Available Scan Me Jinja helpers (already registered globally): qr(data) — base64 QR barcode(data, type) — base64 barcode qr_link(doctype, name) — QR to desk URL qr_link_img(doctype, name) — verify_qr(doctype, name) — QR payload for /verify_document verify_qr_img(doctype, name) — for verify -#}
{{ doc.doctype | upper }}
{% if doc.get('customer_name') or doc.get('supplier_name') %} {% endif %}

Party {{ doc.customer_name or doc.supplier_name }}
{% if doc.get('items') %}
Items
{% for item in doc.items %} {% endfor %}
# Item Code Description Qty Rate Amount
{{ item.idx }} {{ item.item_code or '' }} {{ item.item_name or '' }} {%- set _d = (item.description or '').strip() -%} {%- if _d and _d != item.item_name %}
{{ _d }}{% endif -%} 		{{ item.qty or '' }} {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(item.rate or 0, currency=doc.currency) }} {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(item.amount or 0, currency=doc.currency) }}
{% if doc.get('net_total') %} {% endif %} {% if doc.get('total_taxes_and_charges') %} {% endif %}
Net Total {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.net_total, currency=doc.currency) }}
Total Taxes {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.total_taxes_and_charges, currency=doc.currency) }}
Grand Total {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.rounded_total or doc.grand_total or 0, currency=doc.currency) }}
{% endif %} {% if doc.get('terms') %}
